body.condition: For every \(a\in\{0,1\}\) and \(\ell\in\{1,\ldots,K\}\), on \(\{R=a,C\ge\ell-1,D_{\ell-1}^a=0\}\), \(\mathsf P(C\ge\ell\mid R=a,C\ge\ell-1,D_{\ell-1}^a=0,\mathcal H_K^a)=\mathsf P(C\ge\ell\mid R=a,C\ge\ell-1,D_{\ell-1}^a=0,\mathcal H_{\ell-1}^a)\) almost surely.
